key_insight: Nano- and micro-textures in perovskite solar cells do more than trap light: they also improve wetting, crystallinity, carrier extraction, and potentially mechanical stability.
engineering_relevance: Texture design is a multi-function engineering lever that can raise efficiency and device robustness in perovskite photovoltaics, with spillover value for photodetectors and LEDs.
method: Review of recently reported texture-related benefits beyond light management
Examines effects on perovskite-solution wetting and film formation
Summarizes impacts on crystallinity, charge extraction, and mechanical stability
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a literature survey of recent studies rather than a single new experiment, synthesizing reported improvements in efficiency-related and mechanical metrics.
watch_item: Texture benefits may depend strongly on the specific texture geometry, fabrication process, and perovskite formulation, so gains may not transfer universally.
paper_title: More than just light management -- The multiple advantages of nano- and micro-textures in perovskite solar cells
